title: 2x2 Mach–Zehnder Interferometer (MZI)
summary: Implement a 2x2 MZI using two 2x2 couplers connected by two interferometer arms, providing 2 inputs and 2 outputs with interference-dependent transfer between outputs.

blocks.role: 2x2 MZI (integrated: input coupler + two arms + output coupler)
blocks.notes: Use two 2x2 couplers (typically 50:50) forming an MZI with two internal arms. Phase control not specified (no heater/modulator unless added later). Expose 2 optical input ports and 2 optical output ports.

objective.target_behavior: 2x2 MZI: interference-based 2x2 transfer matrix determined by relative phase between arms (bar/cross behavior tunable if phase shift is provided; otherwise fixed by path length difference).
